record.question: A 30 yr old man with history of substance abuse presented with history of fever, nausea and jaundice of 5 days duration. The biochemical test revealed a bilirubin of 6.7 mg/dl(conjugated 5.0mg/dl) with SGOT/SGPT(AST/ALT) of 1230/900IU/ml. The serological test showed presence of HbsAg,IgM Anti-HBc abd Hbe Ag. The most likely diagnosis is?
options: Chronic hepatitis B infection with high infectivity
Acute hepatitis B infection with high infectivity
Chronic hepatitis B infection with low infectivity
Acute hepatitis B infection with low infectivity
